 Order

Applicant has filed this application for grant of temporary bail u/s 483 of B.N.S.S. who has been arrested on 17.07.2023 in connection with Crime No. 879/2022 registered at Police Station - Nepanagar, District Burhanpur for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 409, 406/34 of IPC and Section 58(B) of M.P. Sahkari Society Adhiniyam, 1960.
3. It is submitted by learned counsel for applicant that elder brother of applicant has expired on 30.10.2025 and applicant is required to perform last rituals.
The factum regarding death of elder brother of applicant has been verified by the State.
Therefore, it is prayed that applicant be enlarged on temporary bail for the appropriate period.

4. Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, temporary bail application is allowed and applicant be released on temporary NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:56131 2 MCRC-51558-2025 bail till 16.11.2025.

5. It is directed that the applicant be released on temporarily bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court.
6. It is directed that applicant shall surrender immediately on 17.11.2025 before the concerned trial Court.

Counsel for the applicant is also directed that when applicant will surrender before concerned Competent Magistrate, certified copy of the order sheet of the concerned Competent Magistrate regarding his surrender shall be filed by him.

Further, the surrender report of the applicant shall be Sudhir vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/64245144/
1 submitted by the concerned Competent Magistrate to the Registry of this Court for information.
7.
